current.text: Wendell Carter Jr. is projected as Orlando's starting center, next to Jalen Suggs, Desmond Bane, Franz Wagner and Paolo Banchero. Nikola Vucevic is the backup center.
He is expected to stay under 30 minutes a game. Vucevic should take about 21 to 22 minutes and Goga Bitadze will also get some minutes at center.
Orlando has a new head coach, Sean Sweeney, who replaces Jamahl Mosley. His rotation preferences are not known yet.
He is not draftable in leagues of 12 teams or fewer. His Yahoo rank of about 125 is too high, and ESPN's rank of 174 is fair.

durable.text: His shot-blocking, three-point volume and passing have disappeared. He is a boring player with no upside.
His real value is defense that does not show up on the stat sheet. He does not help fantasy teams and needs to become a more reliable shooter.
No category stands out. His best categories are rebounds and turnovers, and both are only a little above the pool. His blocks are low for a center.
